evidence.quote: Our results use the Qwen3 dense grouped-query attention family (4B, 8B, and 14B) within the sequential four-agent chain of [32]. Extension to other backbone families (MoE, non-GQA) and to other multi-agent topologies remains to be verified.

Finally, our evaluation uses reasoning, QA, and code benchmarks; performance on real-world multi-agent applications such as long-form collaboration, tool use, or full agentic workflows remains untested.
The denoising interpretation and OBF’s gain over plain eviction are consistent with our results but unverified at the mechanism level.
OBF’s residual SVD adds per-relay compute beyond the base selector; a fast Gram-based alternative is characterized in Appendix H.

Several OBF design choices (PCA rank, demand-ratio scaling, uniform injection) are empirical defaults rather than principled, and we do not fully explain why compressed relay helps on some benchmarks but not others.
